doc.title: Al Vollmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017

chapter: Jazz's place and the band's future
title: Musicians asking interviewers for gigs
summary: Rowe notes interviewees often asked him for work, with a joke about bringing players to Hamilton.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well I noticed you are hitting on something that I know exactly what you’re saying because early on I was doing these interviews and at the end of it many musicians would basically hit me up for a gig.
They’d hit me up for a gig. They would ask, I didn’t phrase that very well. But they’d ask about, “Look why don’t you bring me.”
Sure. And at first I was really surprised, because I had the same thing, like oh my God these are people I’ve been listening to all my life, don’t they have it made?
